training_history: E6 matched 4-layer scratch model trained for 64 updates on 1,024 pairs with fp32 training compute; all three checkpoints evaluated with FP32 model parameters and inference compute.
evaluation: constructed MS MARCO mined-triplet validation candidate lists; not leaderboard comparable
zero_candidate_policy: Cannot rank an empty list; exclude from metric denominator and report the count.
no_relevant_policy: Include nonempty candidate lists; MRR@10 and nDCG@10 are zero when no candidate is relevant.
tie_break: document ID ascending when scores tie
input_format: [CLS] query [SEP] document [SEP] with token-type IDs and attention mask

inference_timing.scope: full validation: tokenization, FP32 scoring, sorting, writing; excludes loading
